description: NaErO₂ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four ErO₆ octahedra, edges with five NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with seven ErO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-13°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.64 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four ErO₆ octahedra, edges with five NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with seven ErO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-13°. There are four shorter (2.39 Å) and two longer (2.66 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Er³⁺ sites. In the first Er³⁺ site, Er³⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form ErO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ErO₆ octahedra, corners with four NaO₆ octahedra, edges with five ErO₆ octahedra, and edges with seven NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-13°. There are two shorter (2.25 Å) and four longer (2.27 Å) Er-O bond lengths. In the second Er³⁺ site, Er³⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form ErO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ErO₆ octahedra, corners with four NaO₆ octahedra, edges with five ErO₆ octahedra, and edges with seven NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-13°. There are four shorter (2.26 Å) and two longer (2.27 Å) Er-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O²⁻ sites. In the first O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to three Na¹⁺ and three Er³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Er₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-11°. In the second O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to three Na¹⁺ and three Er³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Er₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-11°.
